title: Silent Instructions · Teams
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Silent Instructions · Teams with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Put a pencil and sheet of paper on a table and choose a partner. The lead uses gestures only to ask the partner to place the pencil in one of three agreed positions on the paper. The partner places the pencil in the intended position. Form two teams. Each team has four turns; only the lead’s teammates respond or assist. Each success earns the team one point. The higher team score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4–8 players; materials: Paper and pencil.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Silent Instructions, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The partner places the pencil in the intended position.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: The partner places the pencil in the intended position.
